name: gamepad-grimoire
description: Dev tooling for the Gamepad Grimoire World of Warcraft addon (the addon itself is Lua).

scripts.format: stylua src spec && python -m ruff format tools
scripts.format:check: stylua --check src spec && python -m ruff format --check tools
scripts.lint: node tools/lua.mjs luacheck . && python -m ruff check tools
scripts.coverage: node tools/lua.mjs sh -c "busted --coverage -o utfTerminal && luacov" && node tools/coverage.mjs 90
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && python -m pytest -q
